sentence: This project studies the metabolic reactions to brain hemorrhage and which of them are linked to patient outcomes.
This project uses a computational study to develop closed-loop deep-brain stimulation for Parkinson’s disease and other disorders caused by abnormal firing rhythms of neurons.
This project uses machine learning with ecological momentary assessment data to find factors that predict children’s eating behaviors.
This project studies how genetic interactions link the modules of a mammalian cell and how rewiring them gives rise to disease states.
This project builds and describes mouse models to help researchers understand skin biology and disease.
This project explores an implant that targets the vagus nerve to try to reverse Type 2 Diabetes without drugs.
This project uses a genetically tractable model system to find how infection in early childhood disrupts brain development.
This project tests whether extracellular vesicles carrying autoantigens can suppress T cell responses and treat a mouse model of multiple sclerosis.
This project tests whether a genetic risk score followed by MRI can find clinically relevant prostate cancer in men.
This project studies how a cellular immune factor protects against pathogens by selectively repressing their DNA.
This project studies genes that control how a human fungus turns from part of the microbiome into a pathogen.
This project builds computer tools that predict how chemicals are broken down and how much reaches zebrafish, human lung cell cultures and people.
This project looks for genetic variants that raise the risk of orofacial cleft birth defects and tests what they do in mouse models.
This project builds organ-on-a-chip microdevices that model heart injury after a heart attack.
This project studies how upstream open reading frames control mRNA stability and translation in a whole-organism model system.
This project builds a drug discovery platform to find natural products that could treat mild cognitive impairment linked to Alzheimer’s disease.
This project studies how the mother’s blood vessels adapt to pregnancy and to low oxygen during pregnancy, focusing on uterine artery blood flow.
This project develops a molecule, carried in platelets, that breaks down ferritin to help prevent cancer from coming back after surgery.
This project builds and tests a walkway that gives safe balance challenges to assess and train older adults at risk of falling.
